technical.title: Technical competences
technical.label: What's the new Technical competence?
technical.tooltip: Technical competences are specific skills required to work in a determined field, examples:  JavaScript, Calculation and English (Hard skills).

general.title: General competences
general.label: What's the new General Competence?
general.tooltip: General competences are essencial skills that are useful in different fields, examples: Comunication, problem solving and teamwork (Soft skills).
